full_source_order_linearization: Let Gamma be a set of sentences. Gamma is complete if and only if, for every sentence A, either A belongs to Gamma or not A belongs to Gamma. Source-order mathematics: Gamma; then A; then A belongs to Gamma; then not A belongs to Gamma.

accessible_name: Proposition: Properties of complete consistent sets
full_source_order_linearization: Suppose Gamma is complete and consistent. First, if Gamma syntactically derives A, then A belongs to Gamma. Second, the conjunction of A and B belongs to Gamma if and only if both A belongs to Gamma and B belongs to Gamma. Third, the disjunction of A and B belongs to Gamma if and only if either A belongs to Gamma or B belongs to Gamma. Fourth, the conditional from A to B belongs to Gamma if and only if either A does not belong to Gamma or B belongs to Gamma. Source-order mathematics: Gamma; then Gamma syntactically derives A; then A belongs to Gamma; then the conjunction of A and B belongs to Gamma; then A belongs to Gamma; then B belongs to Gamma; then the disjunction of A and B belongs to Gamma; then A belongs to Gamma; then B belongs to Gamma; then the conditional from A to B belongs to Gamma; then A does not belong to Gamma; then B belongs to Gamma.

accessible_name: Definition: Canonical valuation from Gamma star
full_source_order_linearization: Suppose Gamma star is a complete consistent set of formulas. Define valuation v of Gamma star as follows. For each propositional variable p, the valuation assigns verum when p belongs to Gamma star, and assigns falsum when p does not belong to Gamma star. Source-order mathematics: Gamma star; then valuation v of Gamma star assigns verum to p when p belongs to Gamma star, and assigns falsum to p otherwise.

accessible_name: Source-only proposition: Quantifiers in the term model
full_source_order_linearization: Let term model M of Gamma star be the term model from the preceding definition. First, the model satisfies the existential formula there exists an x such that A of x if and only if it satisfies A of t for at least one closed term t. Second, the model satisfies the universal formula for every x, A of x if and only if it satisfies A of t for every closed term t. This source-only first-order proposition is not presented as propositional content. Source-order mathematics: term model M of Gamma star; then structure M of Gamma star satisfies the formula there exists an x such that A of x; then structure M of Gamma star satisfies A of t; then t; then structure M of Gamma star satisfies the formula for every x, A of x; then structure M of Gamma star satisfies A of t; then t.

accessible_name: Lemma: Truth Lemma for the canonical valuation
full_source_order_linearization: For every formula A, valuation v of Gamma star satisfies A if and only if A belongs to Gamma star. Source-order mathematics: valuation v of Gamma star satisfies A; then A belongs to Gamma star.
